messages.content: amar mone hoy ami khub easily attach hoye jai manusher sathe, tarpor eta amake hurt kore
That quick attachment usually comes from a genuine openness, which is actually a good quality even though it makes you more vulnerable. Ki hoy jokhon attach hoye jao, expectation ta ki thake?
ami dhore nei j onno jon o same level e feel korche, pore dekhi eta na

That mismatch in pace is probably the real source of the hurt, more than the attachment itself. Ekta helpful practice hote pare - attach howar shomoy, nijer feeling ta check koro reality er sathe, matching evidence ache kina onno jon er side theke.
